headline: 3-0, 25:39, and a division game that will not care
dek: First AFC West road game of 3-0, favored -5.5 on a 45.5 total.

analysis.body: That is the only time Kansas City asked the vertical shot to carry a drive, and Miami took it.
The Dolphins still scored 10 because Drue Tranquill blew up a Willis keeper that became a fumble Kansas City challenged.

whatWorked: Two Miami turnovers — Willis fumble (Tranquill) and Karlaftis interception (Jones in the play)

matchups.note: The Rodriguez INT was the only deep-middle miss. Keep the ball on time.

coaching.detail: Indianapolis was 117 on the ground; Miami was 88 and a stuff at the 12.

debates: Can Spagnuolo keep posting 10-point nights if the takeaways dry up and the opponent runs for 119?

runOfShow.talkTrack: Do not call it a night game — it was Sun Sep 27, 12:00 PM CT, midday, and the clock still looked like 2025.
